customers_say: Customers find this water purifier to be among the best in the market, offering excellent value with transparent pricing and the ability to save on service costs. The installation process receives positive feedback, and customers report it has been working reliably for up to two years without issues. They appreciate its premium appearance and water quality, noting it makes a noticeable difference in water purity. The taste receives mixed reviews, with some customers finding it excellent while others disagree.

reviews.author: Santosh Nangare
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.body: "The Native M1 is an amazing water purifier. It has a very sleek and modern design that looks great in the kitchen. The 10-stage filtration gives complete peace of mind about water safety. The taste of the water improved instantly after installation. Great value for money and totally hassle-free!" 👍

reviews.author: Dev
reviews.title: Excellent Purifier
reviews.body: The installation process was flawless. The technician who installed my purifier was incredibly knowledgeable. He took the time to explain how the system actually works behind the scenes and shared several important details that the company doesn’t explicitly mention in the standard specs sheet. Knowing these "hidden" engineering details makes me appreciate the product even more. The water taste is excellent, and the build quality feels premium.
